description: Every custom record this review adds to a BDB (H) entry. A custom record shows first for every use of its entry, Tanakh and New Testament alike, so each one was checked against the entry's Old Testament uses, and against every New Testament occurrence it lists, read with the Greek of its SBLGNT verse.
